feeds.title: Washington Integrative Mental Health Services Blog
feeds.description: At Washington Integrative Mental Health Services, LLC, they believe that the human spirit is resilient and has the ability to heal itself when provided with the right nourishment and environment. They focus on what is already healthy and whole within you and, as a team, they work with you to design a pathway for you to live your healthiest and most meaningful life. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, facilities, informational articles, and more discussing on mental health.

feeds.title: New Era Recovery and Behavioral Health LLC Blog
feeds.description: New Era Recovery and Behavioral Health LLC in Washington, DC, offers integrative behavioral health care to children, teens, and adults challenged by the spectrum of mental health disorders. The practice offers evidence-based psychiatric and behavioral health care provided by licensed and well-experienced individuals. The team aims to eradicate the stigma against behavioral health issues and promote non-judgmental mental health care. Browse their blog and learn more about their recovery services, behavioral health, testimonials, and much more.

feeds.title: The Sibley Group Blog
feeds.description: The Sibley Group was founded by psychotherapist Allison Sibley, PhD to address the needs of residents in and around Washington, DC. Their wide range of training and experience allows them to help with issues that arise at different stages of life. Their group is big enough to offer choices, and small enough to be personalized and responsive. Explore more through their blog about services, featuring posts on family life, communication, boundaries, releasing stress, and much more.

feeds.title: National Council for Mental Wellbeing Blog
feeds.description: The National Council for Mental Wellbeing is an association and the unifying voice of organizations that deliver mental health and substance use recovery services in America. They promote a greater understanding of mental well-being as a core component of comprehensive health and health care. Follow their blog to get insight into the state of the field, new treatment trends, opportunities for organizational excellence, the latest news, events, and more.

feeds.title: Therapy Group of DC Blog
feeds.description: Therapy Group of DC offers in-person therapy in Dupont Circle, Washington DC. For even greater availability and areas of expertise, they have expanded online therapy options via the family of Therapy Group practices. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, therapy insights, challenges, training, careers, articles on mental health, and much more.

feeds.title: Columbia Associates Blog
feeds.description: Columbia Associates has been deeply rooted in the Washington DC Metro community for over 30 years while offering a forward-thinking approach to mental health care. Their vision is to create a united, centralized network of accessible, multi-specialty clinics that offer immediate, superior behavioral health treatment options. They empower their clinicians and customer service teams to provide easy access to high-quality, outcomes-based care to all those who need help, and when they need it most. Explore more about mental health through their blog.

feeds.title: Vital TMS Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Vital TMS Therapy is an integrative practice that specializes in using transcranial magnetic stimulation to address mental health issues and other health conditions. They are a boutique mental health practice that focuses on an individualized approach to TMS Therapy. They work with a small number of patients at a time and design therapy plans specific to the unique needs of each patient. Their objective is to treat for remission, not just response. Get into their blog and learn more about services, resources, testimonials, latest news, and more.

feeds.title: The Women's Center Blog
feeds.description: Since its establishment in 1974, The Women's Center has expanded to offer assistance to people of all gender identities, families, teenagers, and kids. They serve as a training ground for mental health specialists and offer one of the biggest, most esteemed, and most challenging training programs in the area. Through counseling, instruction, support, and advocacy, they aim to dramatically enhance the mental health and wellbeing of all community members. Go through their blog and learn more about services, training, events, articles, and more on mental health.

feeds.title: Active Minds Blog
feeds.description: Active Minds was founded by Alison Malmon when she was a junior at the University of Pennsylvania following the suicide of her older brother, and only sibling, Brian. The blog is dedicated to saving lives and building stronger families and communities through education, research, advocacy, and a focus on young adults. Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest news, services, careers, resources, events, internships, and more.

feeds.title: NBC4 Washington » Mental Health
feeds.description: Take a walk through the NBC4 Washington blog and learn more about their services, latest news, informational articles regarding mental health, events, media, and more.

feeds.title: KFF Health News » Mental Health
feeds.description: Wade through the KFF Health News blog and learn more about mental health services, the latest news, informational articles, and much more.

feeds.title: McClendon Center News
feeds.description: McClendon Center has offered vital services and activities to the most disadvantaged members of the community, enabling them to live more independently and enjoy better quality of life. They use a whole-person approach and offer comprehensive, wraparound services that address both primary care requirements and a wide range of social challenges, including as housing and food instability, access to high-quality healthcare, and a lack of social contact. Their mission is to support and empower people on the journey to becoming their best selves. Explore more through their blog.

feeds.title: Mary`s Center Blog » Mental Health
feeds.description: Dive into her blog and learn more about the latest news, services, careers, education, and more discussing on mental health. Mary's Center embraces all communities and provides high-quality healthcare, education, and social services to build better futures. It offers each participant individualized care on the path toward good health, stability, and economic independence.

feeds.title: Cindy Kim and Associates Counseling & Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Cindy Kim and Associates Counseling and Psychotherapy, their goal is to help you recognize and become your best self. Their focus is to help you gain confidence and develop new skills that will enable you to engage more fully and vibrantly within friendships, relationships, career, and most importantly, with yourself. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, specialties, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Mental Health First Aid
feeds.description: Mental Health First Aid was created in 2001 by Betty Kitchener, a nurse specializing in health education, and Anthony Jorm, a mental health literacy professor, a national non-profit health promotion charity focused on training and research. Visit their blog and learn more about the latest news, updates on the mental health movement sweeping the country, stories, thoughts, reflections, and more.

feeds.title: Hope+Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Hope+wellness is a premier therapy and counseling practice with a unique story. It was created based on their philosophy that hope can be found even in the most difficult seasons of life. They provide kind, compassionate care grounded in science-backed treatments to help you feel deeply seen and heard and to help you live at your highest capacity. Take a walk through their blog and learn more about their services, testimonials, reviews, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Black Mental Wellness Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Black Mental Wellness, Corp. is to provide access to evidence-based information and resources about mental health and behavioral health topics from a Black perspective, to highlight and increase the diversity of mental health professionals, and to decrease the mental health stigma in the Black community. Wade through their blog and learn more about mental health, wellness from a variety of experts in the mental health field, health and fitness, clergy, the beauty industry, and so much more.

feeds.title: A Fresh Start Therapy Blog
feeds.description: A Fresh Start Therapy is a minority, locally-owned behavioral and mental health therapy practice located in Washington, D.C. They collaborate with their clients to impact change, allowing them to live healthy lives. From work-based problems to past traumatic experiences, their staff is highly trained, solutions-oriented, empathic, and responsive to their clients, enabling them to leave their care feeling better. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, holistic and behavioral therapies, informational articles, and more regarding mental health and wellness.

feeds.title: Power Counseling PLLC Blog
feeds.description: At Power Counseling PLLC, their expertise includes behavior problems in children, anger management, infidelity, addiction, and working with adult sex offenders. Helping you improve your mental health is their top priority. Through their collaborative approach, they will assess your situation, explore underlying influences, and provide the necessary guidance to develop self-discipline, healthier relationships, and the ability to resist destructive impulses. Take a walk through their blog and learn more about services, therapies, informational videos, articles, and more.

feeds.title: The Trauma Resilience and Education Center of Greater Washington, D.C. Blog
feeds.description: Trauma Resilience and Education Center of Greater Washington, DC is a collective of psychotherapists, educators, and researchers with decades of experience dedicated to providing evidence-based and trauma-informed services. They serve adolescents and adults who have experienced trauma and are struggling to return to a life they value living. Their approach aims to destigmatize mental health therapy within an empowering and affirming context. Dive into their blog and learn more about their services, therapies, training, community, articles, and more on mental health.
